question: Can you provide the highest and lowest profits for Italian customers segmented into ten evenly divided tiers based on their December 2021 sales profits?
sql:
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT 
        p.cust_id,
        SUM(p.unit_price * p.quantity_sold - p.unit_cost * p.quantity_sold) as total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE t.calendar_year = 2021 
      AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
      AND c.country_id = 52770
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_id,
        total_profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as decile
    FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT 
    cust_id,
    total_profit,
    decile
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE total_profit IN (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) FROM ranked_customers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT MAX(total_profit) FROM ranked_customers
)
ORDER BY total_profit
